admissible_witness_test.kind_a: a class present in that module's PRIMARY artifact - its main, unclassified, non-'original-', non-'-tests' JAR - and absent from every other module's artifacts
admissible_witness_test.kind_b: failing that, a module-exclusive META-INF/maven/**/pom.properties node, named as the weaker witness
admissible_witness_test.witness_example_selection_rule: any exclusive class satisfies the rule; the one NAMED is the alphabetically first plain top-level org.apache.spark class among the exclusive set, falling back to the alphabetically first non-META-INF, non-inner class and then to the alphabetically first candidate - deterministic, so a rerun names the same witness
